port_forwarding.description: Enable user-mode port forwarding (required for container networking in most cases).

net_cidr.description: IPv4 CIDR block for the internal slirp4netns network (guest subnet).

host_ip.description: IPv4 address assigned to the host (outside) interface inside the guest network.

guest_ip.description: IPv4 address assigned to the guest (container) interface.

guest_dns.description: IPv4 address of the DNS server advertised to the guest (leave blank to inherit from host’s /etc/resolv.conf).

guest_hostname.description: Hostname to assign to the guest (if hostname_forwarding is enabled).

hostname_forwarding.description: If true, forwards the container’s hostname to the guest network namespace.

natp.description: Enable legacy NAT port redirection (usually keep enabled).

dhcp_server.description: Enable the built-in DHCP server for automatic IP assignment in guests.

ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 support in slirp4netns (experimental; not recommended for production).

ipv6_prefix.description: IPv6 prefix for the guest network (only used if ipv6 is enabled).

ipv6_host.description: IPv6 address of the host interface inside the guest network (only used if ipv6 is enabled).

tap_ifname.description: Name of TAP interface to create (for advanced use with --netns-type=tap). Leave empty to use veth (default).

mtu.description: Maximum Transmission Unit (MTU) for the slirp interface. High values reduce fragmentation overhead.

vlan.description: Enable VLAN tagging (advanced; only if using VLAN-aware network namespaces).

vlan_id.description: VLAN ID (only used if vlan is enabled).

port_mappings.description: List of port mappings to expose container ports to the host. Format: host_ip:host_port:guest_ip:guest_port.

host_ip.description: Host IP to bind the port to (e.g., 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0, or empty for default).

host_port.description: Host port to forward from (0 to let slirp4netns pick an ephemeral port).

guest_ip.description: Guest IP (container IP) to forward to.

guest_port.description: Guest port to forward to (e.g., 80 for HTTP).

extra_options.description: Additional command-line-style options to pass directly to slirp4netns (e.g., '--disable-host-loopback').
